[[File:Hammertoe's Digsite.jpg|thumb|300px|Hammertoe's Digsite]]

'''Hammertoe's Digsite''' lies in the northern part of the [[Badlands]]. The dig has recently been abandoned by [[Hammertoe Grez|Hammertoe]] and taken over by a gang of [[Dark Iron dwarf|Dark Irons]], presumably part of the same force that has moved into [[Uldaman]].
